title: Every comparison table in a report to you has a gold-standard column
why: Your gripe, Oct 27 (iOS kit consultation): "in all these tables include like 'gold standard' so i can get an idea of whats going on as i'm such a noob".
note: Fix, needs no answer: the shiv-stylisms output style says a comparison table in a reply or report to you carries a gold-standard or target column, so each row shows what good looks like. A check, if one fits: the reply judge flags a comparison table with no such column. The consultation thread already works this way. Port: yes; the output style installs everywhere. Placed after c86, ahead of c75's slot (triage, Oct 27): a cheap change to every report you read.
